name: Level 3: Martian Surface
objective: Take photographs and collect samples while surviving the sandstorm and extreme cold.
briefing: When a sandstorm begins, find shelter behind rocks, stop all scientific activities, and activate Low Power Mode. The dust is so dense that sunlight cannot reach the solar panels.
After the storm, the temperature will drop to -125 °C. Activate Hibernation Mode to protect the rover's batteries. If the rover is not close enough to a lava tunnel, it will be destroyed.

phases.objective: Follow Laika to the research area.
Laika explains the photography mission. Use the camera to take pictures of marked locations.
Take photographs of all marked camera buttons. A shutter sound will play for each photo taken.
Sandstorm rolling in! Find shelter behind the rocks, stop all activities, and activate Low Power Mode.
The temperature is dropping to -125 °C. Activate Hibernation Mode to protect the rover.
Hibernation Mode activated. The rover is protected from the cold. Wait for the temperature to stabilize.
Level 3 complete. Return to the briefing screen.
